title: European groups’ papers are 56% international; US groups’ 32%, Chinese groups’ 21%
sub:
Paper grain: 22,939 OpenAlex works published 2013–2025 and linked as the primary paper of a PRIDE dataset (of 23,000; 61 lack author countries).
International = authors’ institutions in ≥2 countries. Country in b = the depositing group’s country. Bands and bars: 95% bootstrap over groups.
